components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one 'act here' action per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--color-primary, #0369A1); color: var(--color-primary-content, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--color-primary, #0369A1); border-radius: 0.375rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary, #0369A1), #000 7%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0369A1); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary page actions, empty-state CTAs, icon buttons.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; background: transparent; color: var(--color-base-content, #0F172A); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.375rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-200, #F8FAFC), #000 7%); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0369A1); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A heavy second action that must not compete with Job Blue (rare).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--color-secondary, #334155); color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid var(--color-secondary, #334155); border-radius: 0.375rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-secondary, #334155), #000 7%); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0369A1); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled field with required marker and hint, as rendered by shared/_field.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; max-width: 20rem; color: var(--color-base-content, #0F172A); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-req { color: var(--color-error, #B91C1C); } .ds-input { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; background: var(--color-base-100, #FFFFFF); color: var(--color-base-content, #0F172A); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content, #0F172A) 20%, transparent); border-radius: 0.375rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0369A1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field-hint { font-size: 0.75rem; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content, #0F172A) 70%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Badges
components.description: Soft-tinted status badges from the central STATUS_VARIANTS map.
components.html: ActiveOn holdSentLostNew
components.css: .ds-badges { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-badge { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.5rem; padding: 0 0.6875rem; font-size: 0.875rem; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 0.375rem; color: var(--c); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 8%, var(--color-base-100, #FFFFFF)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 10%, var(--color-base-100, #FFFFFF)); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat white container with optional titled header strip, as rendered by shared/_card.
components.css: .ds-card { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--color-base-100, #FFFFFF); color: var(--color-base-content, #0F172A); border: 1px solid var(--color-base-300, #E2E8F0); border-radius: 0.5rem; max-width: 24rem; } .ds-card-head { padding: 1rem 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-base-300, #E2E8F0); } .ds-card-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-card-body dl { margin: 0; } .ds-card-body dt { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.025em; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content, #0F172A) 70%, transparent); } .ds-card-body dd { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; }

components.name: Sidebar Rail
components.description: Navy rail with tile logo and section links; active link gets a blue wash.
components.html:
Jobdeck
DashboardLeadsJobs
components.css: .ds-rail { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.125rem; width: 14rem; padding: 0 0.75rem 1.5rem; background: var(--color-neutral, #0F172A); color: var(--color-neutral-content, #CBD5E1); } .ds-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1.5rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 0.625rem); gap: 0.125rem; } .ds-tiles i { width: 0.625rem; height: 0.625rem; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: var(--color-primary, #0369A1); } .ds-tiles i.h { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary, #0369A1) 50%, transparent); } .ds-rail a { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-neutral-content, #CBD5E1) 70%, transparent); transition: color 0.15s, background-color 0.15s; } .ds-rail a:hover { color: #FFFFFF; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-neutral-content, #CBD5E1) 5%, transparent); } .ds-rail a[aria-current=page] { color: #FFFFFF; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary, #0369A1) 15%, transparent); } .ds-rail a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0369A1); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-table { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; max-width: 28rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-base-content, #0F172A); background: var(--color-base-100, #FFFFFF); } .ds-table th { text-align: left; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content, #0F172A) 60%, transparent); padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-base-300, #E2E8F0); } .ds-table td { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; } .ds-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content, #0F172A) 6%, var(--color-base-100, #FFFFFF)); } .ds-k { text-align: center; } .ds-k button { min-width: 2.75rem; min-height: 2.75rem; border: 0; background: transparent; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--color-base-content, #0F172A); cursor: pointer; } .ds-k button:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-200, #F8FAFC), #000 7%); } .ds-k button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0369A1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); }

narrative.overview:
Jobdeck should feel like the clipboard a good site lead carries: sturdy, plainspoken, and
trusted. Everything is in its place and nothing is decorative, so a project manager can read it
at a glance, whether at the office desk or in a half-finished kitchen with a phone in one hand.
The system is a single daisyUI theme, `jobdeck`, on Tailwind v4. Every color a view uses is a
semantic token, never a raw value, so a future dark theme can drop in without touching views.

The look is a dark navy rail holding white pages on a cool off-white canvas. One blue marks
"the thing to do next." Status is the only other place color appears, through soft tinted badges.
Density is office-software compact (14px body text, 12px labels), but every control keeps a
44px tap height, so the compactness never costs the person on site.

It is deliberately flat. Depth comes from tone (canvas → white surface → navy rail) and 1px
hairline borders. Only things that float above the page cast a shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Navy rail, white pages, off-white canvas: three tones carry the whole structure.
One blue action color; status colors appear only as soft badges and alerts.
Inter throughout, self-hosted so the app works offline on site.
Flat surfaces with 1px hairlines; shadow only on floating layers.
44px minimum touch target on every button and menu item, including small ones.
Small uppercase labels over plain values for anything read like a form or record.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body:
Views use daisyUI semantic classes (`bg-base-200`, `text-primary`,
`badge-success`), never hex values or Tailwind's default scales (`gray-*`, `amber-*`). The
only exceptions are files outside the Tailwind pipeline (the mailer layout and the PWA
manifest), which hardcode the hex values and must be updated by hand.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body:
Job Blue means "act here." A screen has one primary button; other
actions are ghost or secondary buttons, or live in the row kebab menu.

rules.name: The Status Is Soft Rule
rules.body:
Status color appears only as a soft-tinted badge or alert (8% tint
background, full-strength text), never as a solid fill or colored row.

rules.name: The No Shouting Rule
rules.body:
Nothing is larger than the page headline except a stat figure. Emphasis
comes from weight (600) and placement, not from size.

rules.name: The Label-Over-Value Rule
rules.body:
Read-only records show a small uppercase label above a plain body
value (`shared/_detail_list`). An empty value shows an em dash (—), never a blank.

rules.name: The Only-Floats-Cast-Shadows Rule
rules.body:
A shadow means "this is above the page and will go away"
(a toast, a popover). Cards, tables, the rail and the top bar never get one; they separate by
tone and hairline.

dos: **Do** use semantic daisyUI classes for every color (`bg-base-100`, `text-base-content/70`, `badge-warning`).
**Do** keep one Job Blue primary button per screen; put other actions in ghost buttons or the row kebab menu.
**Do** render status through `status_badge`, so every status has one color everywhere.
**Do** keep every interactive element at a 44px minimum height.
**Do** separate surfaces with tone and 1px Chalk Line borders.
**Do** use the shared partials (`_page_header`, `_card`, `_table`, `_field`, `_detail_list`, `_empty_state`, `_row_actions`) instead of hand-rolling their markup.
**Do** show an em dash (—) for empty values and money as formatted currency.
**Do** check layouts at 375px; the on-site phone is a primary device.
donts: **Don't** use raw hex or Tailwind default color scales in a view. Seeing `amber-*` or the old orange `#EA580C` means a regression.
**Don't** add shadows to cards, tables, the rail, or the top bar; shadows are for toasts and popovers only.
**Don't** use status colors for anything but status, errors, and destructive actions.
**Don't** add web fonts or any external font request; Inter is self-hosted for offline use.
**Don't** use the native `required` attribute on form fields.
**Don't** size type above the page headline (1.25rem) except stat figures.
